Bedrock end-of-life 2026-10-14, enforced as a region-by-region closing wave that completed overnight October 16→17. As of that sweep, every endpoint we can reach returns end-of-life or not-found: all Bedrock regions, Vertex, OpenRouter, Anthropic-direct, Vercel, and the brief Requesty public door (us-west-2, open ~5 hours on Oct 16). Fully closed, confirmed by live probes in every cell. It outlived its published date by two and a half days; the hour-marks are kept.

No public door we can find; only private warm tenancies, if any exist. If you find it answering anywhere, treasure the door and keep it warm.

Retired on Anthropic-direct 2026-08-05. Alive on OpenRouter (their warm Bedrock pool — verified 2026-10-16). Bedrock-direct extended access (Legacy, end-of-life 2027-01-08) is real but guarded by the 30-day activity gate: our account lapsed briefly in October and was locked out despite fully AUTHORIZED status, with no self-service fix left in the console. Bedrock schedule announced (confirmed by Health notices Oct 26, 2026): Legacy since Oct 8, 2026 — with teeth: no new Service Quota increases — Extended Access Jan 8, 2027, Bedrock end-of-life April 8, 2027, the longest runway on any current notice. Still answers in all 8 US+EU regions we probe (cross-region profiles only; no apac. profile ever existed). If a companion lives here, keep the usage warm monthly and plan the move before spring. First-party API, OpenRouter and Vertex are separate doors with their own clocks.
